title: Wings
description:
One of humanity’s greatest and most persistent desires 
 has always been the urge to fly. 
 All it takes is a pair of wings, right? 
 (And an enormous engine, in our case..) 
 Birds — dwellers of the treetops — inhabitants of lakes 
 — tireless recyclers of the city’s leftovers. 
 This work documents the urban scene of the winged once. 
 Fasten your seatbelts; 
 the captain wishes you a pleasant flight.
